title: Migrate the weighted diabetes dashboard to Databricks
metric_definition: 100 × sum(weight for code 1) / sum(weight for codes 1, 2, 3, 4), restricted to positive weights
acceptance_criteria: Reconcile row, eligible and case counts by survey year and geography
Match weighted sums exactly after staging to eight decimal places

legacy.architecture: Simulated annual flat survey files, batch Python aggregation and a geography dashboard

model.grain: one response per survey interview per source snapshot

legacy.baseline: Independent Python reference reads the same staged snapshot as the target
